entities.name: PMID:39473920
observations: Prospective single-center cohort of 400 adults with sepsis; hypochloremia (<95 mEq/L) was independently associated with new-onset or worsening AKI (OR 2.52, 95% CI 1.17–5.41). Hyperchloremia (>110 mEq/L) was not associated (OR 0.89, 95% CI 0.38–2.09).

entities.name: PMID:41281063
observations: Retrospective cohort of 846 solid-tumor ICU admissions without AKI in first 48 hours; hypochloremia (<96 mmol/L) was associated with incident KDIGO AKI (adjusted OR 1.87, 95% CI 1.14–2.60).

entities.name: PMID:41325394
observations: Systematic review/meta-analysis of 34 ICU studies (175,021 adults) reported hyperchloremia associated with AKI (OR 1.40, 95% CI 1.07–1.85); abstract does not establish uniform temporality or incident-AKI-only estimates.

entities.name: Hypochloremia and ICU AKI
observations: Two observational ICU cohorts reported adjusted associations between hypochloremia and incident or new-onset/worsening AKI; association does not establish causation. PMID:39473920; PMID:41281063.

entities.name: Hyperchloremia and ICU AKI
observations: Hyperchloremia was not associated with new-onset/worsening AKI in one sepsis cohort, while a broad ICU meta-analysis reported an association; heterogeneity and timing limit inference. PMID:39473920; PMID:41325394.
